summary.title: Learn to Build, Deploy and Operate Software with Python
summary.one_liner: Full Stack Python is a former topic-map site (2012–2022) for building, deploying, and operating Python applications, now being updated and moved to a /learn section on plushcap.com.
takeaways: Full Stack Python was a topic-map site from 2012 to 2022 meant to be read after learning basic Python syntax.
The author is updating older topic pages in 2026 and moving them to a /learn section on plushcap.com, marked as human-written with update dates.
Updated pages will be linked from the table of contents with an off-site arrow icon.
Each topic page now aims to include a 'what to prompt to learn more' section for use with LLMs.
summary.summary: This page is the landing page for Full Stack Python, a Python learning site by Matt Makai that ran from 2012 to 2022 and organized concepts and libraries for building, deploying, and operating applications. It explains why the content fell out of date, especially after LLMs such as ChatGPT became common for learning. The author describes three decisions for the revival: keep writing human-written, move updated topics into a /learn section on plushcap.com under his other side project, and add prompts readers can use to learn more with an LLM. The page is mainly a status note and contains few technical details itself.
